name: G4-F2
description: G4-F2 was an R-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. A day after arriving on the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, G4-F2 called into the radio show Droid Station Frequency 3-7-6-4-3-7 on station BSO 401.72 to ask in binary where it could find an oil bath as its joints were aching.
